title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Flower Structure and Function
text:
Flower Structure and Function

Key terms: androecium, gynoecium, pollination

Flowers are the reproductive structures of angiosperms, with male (androecium) and female (gynoecium) parts. They attract pollinators for sexual reproduction.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Flower Structure and Function in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Pollen Grain Development
text:
Pollen Grain Development

Key terms: microspore, meiosis, anther dehiscence

Pollen grains develop from microspores within anthers, going through meiosis to form microspore tetrads. They are released when anthers dehisce.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Pollen Grain Development in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Pollen Grain Structure
text:
Pollen Grain Structure

Key terms: exine, intine, vegetative cell, generative cell

Pollen grains have a hard outer layer (exine) and a thin inner layer (intine). They contain a vegetative cell and a generative cell.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Pollen Grain Structure in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Pistil Structure and Function
text:
Pistil Structure and Function

Key terms: stigma, style, ovary, ovule

The pistil is the female reproductive part of a flower, with stigma for pollen reception, style for pollen tube growth, and ovary for ovule development.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Pistil Structure and Function in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Ovule Structure and Megasporogenesis
text:
Ovule Structure and Megasporogenesis

Key terms: ovule, megaspore mother cell, megasporogenesis, embryo sac

Ovules develop from megaspore mother cells (MMC) that undergo meiosis to form megaspores. The embryo sac develops from a megaspore.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to evaluate concepts related to Ovule Structure and Megasporogenesis in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Ovule Structure and Development
text:
Ovule Structure and Development

Key terms: ovule, megaspores, meiosis, female gametophyte

An ovule is a megaspore mother cell (MMC) that undergoes meiosis to produce four megaspores. In most plants, only one megaspore develops into the female gametophyte (embryo sac).

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Ovule Structure and Development in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Embryo Sac Development
text:
Embryo Sac Development

Key terms: embryo sac, mitosis, nuclei, cell walls

The functional megaspore divides mitotically to form the 2-nucleate, 4-nucleate, and 8-nucleate stages of the embryo sac. After the 8-nucleate stage, cell walls are laid down, forming a 7-celled embryo sac with six cells and two polar nuclei in the central cell.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Embryo Sac Development in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Pollination Types
text:
Pollination Types

Key terms: autogamy, geitonogamy, xenogamy

Pollination can be autogamy (within the same flower), geitonogamy (between flowers of the same plant), or xenogamy (between different plants).

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Pollination Types in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Pollination Agents
text:
Pollination Agents

Key terms: pollination agents, wind pollination, animal pollination

Plants use wind, water, or animals (biotic agents like bees, butterflies, etc.) for pollination. Wind-pollinated flowers are usually small, non-sticky, and have exposed stamens, while animal-pollinated flowers are often large, colorful, and fragrant.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Pollination Agents in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Outbreeding Devices
text:
Outbreeding Devices

Key terms: outbreeding devices, self-pollination, cross-pollination

Flowering plants have developed mechanisms like asynchronous pollen release and stigma receptivity, physical separation of anthers and stigma, self-incompatibility, and production of unisexual flowers to discourage self-pollination and encourage cross-pollination.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Outbreeding Devices in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Pollen-Pistil Interaction
text:
Pollen-Pistil Interaction

Key terms: pollen-pistil interaction, compatible pollen, incompatible pollen

The pistil recognizes compatible pollen and promotes post-pollination events leading to fertilization, while rejecting incompatible pollen by preventing pollen germination or pollen tube growth.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to evaluate concepts related to Pollen-Pistil Interaction in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Pollen Tube Growth and Pollen-Pistil Interaction
text:
Pollen Tube Growth and Pollen-Pistil Interaction

Key terms: pollen tube, pollen-pistil interaction, filiform apparatus

Pollen tubes grow through the stigma and style, reaching the ovary. They enter the ovule through the micropyle, guided by the filiform apparatus. This process, called pollen-pistil interaction, involves pollen recognition and promotion or inhibition.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.topic: Pollen Tube Growth and Pollen-Pistil Interaction
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Pollen Tube Growth and Pollen-Pistil Interaction in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Double Fertilisation
text:
Double Fertilisation

Key terms: double fertilisation, zygote, primary endosperm nucleus

One male gamete fuses with the egg cell to form the zygote, and the other fuses with the two polar nuclei to form the primary endosperm nucleus. This unique event in flowering plants is called double fertilisation.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Double Fertilisation in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Endosperm Development
text:
Endosperm Development

Key terms: endosperm, primary endosperm nucleus, free-nuclear endosperm

The primary endosperm nucleus divides repeatedly to form endosperm tissue, filled with reserve food materials for the developing embryo. Endosperm may be completely consumed or persistent in mature seeds.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Endosperm Development in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Embryo Development
text:
Embryo Development

Key terms: embryo, zygote, embryogeny

The zygote develops into an embryo, with early stages similar in both monocotyledons and dicotyledons. The embryo consists of an embryonal axis and cotyledons, with variations between monocots and dicots.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to evaluate concepts related to Embryo Development in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Seed Structure and Development
text:
Seed Structure and Development

Key terms: seed, fruit, ovule

Seeds consist of seed coat(s), cotyledon(s), and an embryo axis. They are formed inside fruits, with the transformation of ovules into seeds and ovary into fruit proceeding simultaneously.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to create concepts related to Seed Structure and Development in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Apomixis and Polyembryony
text:
Apomixis and Polyembryony

Key terms: apomixis, polyembryony, parthenocarpy

Apomixis is a form of asexual reproduction in flowering plants that mimics sexual reproduction, producing seeds without fertilisation. Polyembryony is the development of multiple embryos in a single seed.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to create concepts related to Apomixis and Polyembryony in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Pollen Grain Structure and Development
text:
Pollen Grain Structure and Development

Key terms: exine, sporopollenin, germ pores, vegetative cell, generative cell, male gametes

Pollen grains have an outer layer called exine, made of sporopollenin and with germ pores. They may have two or three cells at shedding: a vegetative cell and either a generative cell or two male gametes.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Pollen Grain Structure and Development in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Pistil Structure and Ovule Development
text:
Pistil Structure and Ovule Development

Key terms: pistil, stigma, style, ovary, ovule, funicle, integuments, micropyle, archesporium, megaspore mother cell, embryo sac

The pistil has three parts: stigma, style, and ovary. Ovules in the ovary have a funicle, integuments, and a micropyle. The archesporium in the nucellus differentiates into a megaspore mother cell, which forms the embryo sac through meiosis.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Pistil Structure and Ovule Development in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Embryo Sac Structure and Development
text:
Embryo Sac Structure and Development

Key terms: embryo sac, egg apparatus, antipodals, polyembryony

The mature embryo sac is 7-celled and 8-nucleate, with an egg apparatus at the micropylar end and antipodals at the chalazal end. Some nucellar cells may develop into embryos, leading to polyembryony.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Embryo Sac Structure and Development in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Apomixis and Its Importance
text:
Apomixis and Its Importance

Key terms: apomixis, hybrid, progeny, farmer

Apomixis is the formation of seeds without fertilization, which can maintain hybrid characters in the progeny. This is beneficial for farmers as they don't have to buy hybrid seeds every year.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Apomixis and Its Importance in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Human Reproductive Events
text:
Human Reproductive Events

Key terms: gametogenesis, insemination, fertilization, implantation, embryonic development, parturition

Humans are sexually reproducing and viviparous. Reproductive events include gametogenesis, insemination, fertilization, implantation, embryonic development, and delivery.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Human Reproductive Events in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Male Reproductive System
text:
Male Reproductive System

Key terms: testes, seminiferous tubules, sperm, epididymis, vas deferens, prostate, seminal vesicles

The male reproductive system includes testes, accessory ducts, glands, and external genitalia. Testes produce sperms and hormones, while accessory ducts and glands help in sperm transport and ejaculation.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Male Reproductive System in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Female Reproductive System
text:
Female Reproductive System

Key terms: ovaries, oviducts, uterus, cervix, vagina, ovum, hymen, clitoris

The female reproductive system consists of ovaries, oviducts, uterus, cervix, vagina, and external genitalia. Ovaries produce ova and hormones, while other parts support ovulation, fertilization, pregnancy, and childbirth.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Female Reproductive System in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Gametogenesis
text:
Gametogenesis

Key terms: gametogenesis, spermatogenesis, oogenesis, meiosis, spermiogenesis, follicle development

Gametogenesis is the production of gametes (sperms and ova) by testes and ovaries. Spermatogenesis involves meiosis and spermiogenesis, while oogenesis involves meiosis and follicle development.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Gametogenesis in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Menstrual Cycle
text:
Menstrual Cycle

Key terms: menstrual cycle, menstruation, follicular phase, ovulation, luteal phase, hormones

The menstrual cycle is a monthly cycle in females involving menstruation, follicular phase, ovulation, luteal phase, and preparation for the next cycle. It is regulated by hormones.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Menstrual Cycle in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Menstrual Cycle
text:
Menstrual Cycle

Key terms: menstruation, ovulation, hormones

The menstrual cycle is a regular natural change that occurs in the female reproductive system that makes pregnancy possible. It is regulated by hormones and involves four phases: menstrual, follicular, ovulatory, and luteal.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Menstrual Cycle in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Follicular Phase
text:
Follicular Phase

Key terms: Graafian follicle, endometrium, proliferation

The follicular phase is the second phase of the menstrual cycle, during which the primary follicles in the ovary grow to become a fully mature Graafian follicle, and the endometrium of the uterus regenerates through proliferation.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Follicular Phase in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Ovulation
text:
Ovulation

Key terms: luteinizing hormone, Graafian follicle, ovum

Ovulation is the release of a mature ovum from the Graafian follicle, triggered by a surge in luteinizing hormone (LH) levels. This occurs mid-cycle, around day 14 in a typical 28-day menstrual cycle.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Ovulation in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Fertilization
text:
Fertilization

Key terms: sperm, ovum, zygote

Fertilization is the process by which a sperm fertilizes an ovum, resulting in the formation of a zygote. It can only occur if the ovum and sperm are transported simultaneously to the ampullary region of the fallopian tube.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Fertilization in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Implantation
text:
Implantation

Key terms: blastocyst, endometrium, pregnancy

Implantation is the process by which the blastocyst, after traveling through the fallopian tube, attaches to the endometrium of the uterus, marking the beginning of pregnancy.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Implantation in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Pregnancy and Embryonic Development
text:
Pregnancy and Embryonic Development

Key terms: embryo, fetus, hormones

Pregnancy lasts approximately 9 months in humans. During this time, the embryo develops through various stages, including the formation of organs and systems, and the production of hormones essential for fetal growth and maternal support.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Pregnancy and Embryonic Development in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Parturition and Lactation
text:
Parturition and Lactation

Key terms: oxytocin, milk, newborn

Parturition is the process of childbirth, induced by a complex neuroendocrine mechanism involving hormones like oxytocin. Lactation is the process by which the mother produces milk to feed the newborn, starting towards the end of pregnancy.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Parturition and Lactation in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Androgen Production
text:
Androgen Production

Key terms: Androgens, Leydig cells, Testosterone

Androgens, like testosterone, are produced by Leydig cells, not Sertoli cells.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Androgen Production in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Sperm Nutrition
text:
Sperm Nutrition

Key terms: Spermatozoa, Sertoli cells, Nutrition

Spermatozoa get nutrition from Sertoli cells, not the other way around.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Sperm Nutrition in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Leydig Cell Location
text:
Leydig Cell Location

Key terms: Leydig cells, Testes, Ovary

Leydig cells are found in the testes, not the ovary.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Leydig Cell Location in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Oogenesis Location
text:
Oogenesis Location

Key terms: Oogenesis, Ovary, Corpus luteum

Oogenesis takes place in the ovary, not the corpus luteum.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Oogenesis Location in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Menstrual Cycle During Pregnancy
text:
Menstrual Cycle During Pregnancy

Key terms: Menstrual cycle, Pregnancy

The menstrual cycle ceases during pregnancy.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Menstrual Cycle During Pregnancy in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Hymen as Indicator of Virginity
text:
Hymen as Indicator of Virginity

Key terms: Hymen, Virginity, Sexual experience

The presence or absence of the hymen is not a reliable indicator of virginity or sexual experience.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Hymen as Indicator of Virginity in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Menstrual Cycle Regulation
text:
Menstrual Cycle Regulation

Key terms: Menstrual cycle, Estrogen, Progesterone

The menstrual cycle is regulated by hormones, specifically estrogen and progesterone.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Menstrual Cycle Regulation in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Parturition Induction
text:
Parturition Induction

Key terms: Parturition, Oxytocin, Progesterone

Parturition, or childbirth, is induced by hormones like oxytocin and progesterone.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Parturition Induction in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Reproductive Health
text:
Reproductive Health

Key terms: reproductive health, World Health Organization

Reproductive health is about having healthy reproductive organs and normal functions, but it also includes emotional and social aspects of reproduction. According to the World Health Organization, it's about total well-being in all aspects of reproduction.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Reproductive Health in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Reproductive Health Programs
text:
Reproductive Health Programs

Key terms: awareness, sex education, myths

Governments and NGOs create awareness about reproductive health through audio-visual and print media, and encourage sex education in schools to provide accurate information and discourage myths.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Reproductive Health Programs in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Contraceptive Methods
text:
Contraceptive Methods

Key terms: contraceptive methods, natural, barrier, IUDs

Contraceptive methods prevent unwanted pregnancies and include natural, barrier, IUDs, oral contraceptives, injectables, implants, and surgical methods. They should be user-friendly, easily available, effective, and reversible with no or least side-effects.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Contraceptive Methods in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Population Stabilization and Birth Control
text:
Population Stabilization and Birth Control

Key terms: population growth, birth control, contraceptive methods

Rapid population growth can lead to scarcity of resources, so governments motivate smaller families and use contraceptive methods to control population growth.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Population Stabilization and Birth Control in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Medical Termination of Pregnancy (MTP)
text:
Medical Termination of Pregnancy (MTP)

Key terms: MTP, induced abortion, female foeticides

MTP, or induced abortion, is the intentional termination of pregnancy before full term. It's legal in India with certain conditions to avoid misuse and female foeticides.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Medical Termination of Pregnancy (MTP) in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Medical Termination of Pregnancy (MTP)
text:
Medical Termination of Pregnancy (MTP)

Key terms: MTP, abortion, illegal abortion

MTP is a legal procedure to end an unwanted or harmful pregnancy. It's safer during the first 12 weeks. Illegal abortions by unqualified providers are dangerous and often fatal.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Medical Termination of Pregnancy (MTP) in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Grounds for MTP
text:
Grounds for MTP

Key terms: grounds for MTP, risk to life, serious handicap

MTP can be performed if continuing the pregnancy risks the mother's or child's life, or if the child would be seriously handicapped.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Grounds for MTP in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Sexually Transmitted Infections (STIs)
text:
Sexually Transmitted Infections (STIs)

Key terms: STIs, venereal diseases, RTIs

STIs are infections spread through sexual contact. They can cause serious health issues if left untreated, including infertility and cancer.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Sexually Transmitted Infections (STIs) in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Preventing STIs
text:
Preventing STIs

Key terms: STI prevention, safe sex, early detection

STIs can be prevented by avoiding sex with unknown partners, using condoms, and seeking early detection and treatment if infected.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Preventing STIs in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Infertility
text:
Infertility

Key terms: infertility, unable to conceive, causes of infertility

Infertility is the inability to conceive after two years of unprotected sex. It can be caused by physical, congenital, or psychological factors.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Infertility in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Assisted Reproductive Technologies (ART)
text:
Assisted Reproductive Technologies (ART)

Key terms: ART, IVF, ICSI, AI

ART methods like IVF, ICSI, and AI help infertile couples conceive. They require specialized professionals and expensive instrumentation.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Assisted Reproductive Technologies (ART) in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Reproductive Health
text:
Reproductive Health

Key terms: reproductive health, well-being, contraceptives

Reproductive health includes physical, emotional, behavioral, and social well-being in all aspects of reproduction. It's promoted through education, medical care, and contraceptive options.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Reproductive Health in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Reproductive Health Improvements in India
text:
Reproductive Health Improvements in India

Key terms: reproductive health improvements, maternal mortality, STI cure, infertility assistance

India has seen improvements in reproductive health, including reduced maternal and infant mortality rates, early detection and cure of STIs, and assistance to infertile couples.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Reproductive Health Improvements in India in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Mendel's Laws of Inheritance
text:
Mendel's Laws of Inheritance

Key terms: Mendel, inheritance, genes

Gregor Mendel conducted experiments on garden peas to understand inheritance patterns. He proposed laws of inheritance, including the principle that traits are determined by factors (now known as genes).

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Mendel's Laws of Inheritance in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Monohybrid Cross
text:
Monohybrid Cross

Key terms: monohybrid, F1, F2, dominant, recessive

A cross between two true-breeding organisms for one trait. The F1 generation shows the dominant trait, and the F2 generation shows a 3:1 ratio of dominant to recessive traits.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Monohybrid Cross in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Dominance and Recessiveness
text:
Dominance and Recessiveness

Key terms: dominant, recessive, alleles, phenotype

In a pair of alleles, one may be dominant (expressed in the phenotype) and the other recessive (not expressed unless the dominant allele is not present).

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Dominance and Recessiveness in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Test Cross
text:
Test Cross

Key terms: test cross, genotype, phenotype

Crossing an organism with a dominant phenotype with a recessive parent to determine the genotype of the dominant organism.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Test Cross in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Punnett Square
text:
Punnett Square

Key terms: Punnett square, genotypes, genetic cross

A graphical tool used to predict the possible genotypes of offspring in a genetic cross, developed by Reginald C. Punnett.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Punnett Square in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Test Cross
text:
Test Cross

Key terms: test cross, genotype, phenotype, recessive, dominant

A test cross is a genetic cross used to determine the genotype of an organism with a dominant phenotype. It involves crossing the organism with a recessive parent and analyzing the offspring to predict the genotype of the test organism.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Test Cross in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Law of Dominance
text:
Law of Dominance

Key terms: law of dominance, dominant, recessive, heterozygous, homozygous

The law of dominance states that in a heterozygous individual, one trait will dominate the other. The dominant trait is expressed in the phenotype, while the recessive trait is not expressed unless the individual is homozygous for the recessive allele.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Law of Dominance in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Law of Segregation
text:
Law of Segregation

Key terms: law of segregation, alleles, gametes, monohybrid cross

The law of segregation states that during gamete formation, the two alleles of each gene segregate from each other, so that each gamete receives one, and only one, allele for each trait. This results in a 3:1 phenotypic ratio in the F2 generation of a monohybrid cross.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Law of Segregation in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Incomplete Dominance
text:
Incomplete Dominance

Key terms: incomplete dominance, heterozygote, intermediate phenotype

Incomplete dominance occurs when the heterozygote has a phenotype that is intermediate between the two homozygous phenotypes. This is because neither allele is completely dominant over the other.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Incomplete Dominance in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Co-dominance
text:
Co-dominance

Key terms: co-dominance, alleles, heterozygote, phenotype

Co-dominance occurs when both alleles of a gene are expressed in the heterozygote, resulting in a phenotype that is a combination of the two homozygous phenotypes. This is because neither allele is dominant over the other.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Co-dominance in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Law of Independent Assortment
text:
Law of Independent Assortment

Key terms: law of independent assortment, alleles, genes, gametes

The law of independent assortment states that alleles of different genes assort independently during gamete formation. This means that the combination of alleles for one trait is independent of the combination of alleles for another trait.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Law of Independent Assortment in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Independent Assortment of Chromosomes
text:
Independent Assortment of Chromosomes

Key terms: homologous chromosomes, meiosis I, independent assortment

During meiosis I, homologous chromosomes align and segregate independently, leading to different combinations of genes in gametes.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Independent Assortment of Chromosomes in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Linkage and Recombination
text:
Linkage and Recombination

Key terms: linkage, recombination, meiosis

Genes located on the same chromosome tend to be inherited together, but recombination can occur during meiosis, leading to new combinations of genes.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Linkage and Recombination in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Polygenic Inheritance
text:
Polygenic Inheritance

Key terms: polygenic traits, environmental influence, phenotype

Some traits are controlled by multiple genes and are influenced by both genetics and environment, resulting in a range of possible phenotypes.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Polygenic Inheritance in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Pleiotropy
text:
Pleiotropy

Key terms: pleiotropic gene, metabolic pathways, phenotype

A single gene can influence multiple phenotypic traits, often by affecting multiple metabolic pathways.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Pleiotropy in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Sex Determination (XO Type)
text:
Sex Determination (XO Type)

Key terms: XO type, sex chromosomes, sperm determination

Predation

One organism (predator) consuming another (prey), transferring energy and regulating prey populations, with both beneficial and defensive strategies.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Ecosystem Definition
text:
Ecosystem Definition

An ecosystem is a functional unit of nature where living organisms interact with each other and their physical environment. It varies in size from small ponds to large forests or seas, and can be categorized into terrestrial and aquatic ecosystems.

metadata.subject: Biology

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Ecosystem Structure in Grade 12 Biology.

text:

Ecosystem functions include productivity, decomposition, energy flow, and nutrient cycling. These processes work together to maintain the balance within an ecosystem.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Ecosystem Function in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Primary Productivity
text:
Primary Productivity

Primary productivity is the rate of organic matter production by plants during photosynthesis. It is divided into gross primary productivity (GPP) and net primary productivity (NPP).

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Primary Productivity in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Decomposition Process
text:
Decomposition Process

Key terms: decomposition, detritivores, bacteria, fungi, fragmentation, leaching, catabolism, humification, mineralization

Decomposition involves the breakdown of complex organic matter into inorganic substances by detritivores, bacteria, and fungi. It includes fragmentation, leaching, catabolism, humification, and mineralization.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Decomposition Process in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Energy Flow in Ecosystems
text:
Energy Flow in Ecosystems

Key terms: energy flow, food chains, food webs, thermodynamics

Energy flows unidirectionally from the sun to producers, then to consumers, and finally to decomposers. It is influenced by the laws of thermodynamics and is represented by food chains and webs.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to evaluate concepts related to Energy Flow in Ecosystems in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Trophic Levels
text:

Key terms: trophic levels, producers, consumers, decomposers

Trophic levels represent the feeding relationship of organisms in an ecosystem. They are categorized based on the source of their nutrition, with producers at the first level and decomposers at the last.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to create concepts related to Trophic Levels in Grade 12 Biology.

text:

metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to create concepts related to Ecological Pyramids in Grade 12 Biology.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Energy Pyramid Structure in Grade 12 Biology.

metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to India's Biodiversity in Grade 12 Biology.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Latitudinal Gradients in Biodiversity in Grade 12 Biology.

metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Causes of Biodiversity Loss in Grade 12 Biology.

metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to evaluate concepts related to Sixth Mass Extinction in Grade 12 Biology.

metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Mass Extinctions and Causes in Grade 12 Biology.

Loss of biodiversity can lead to decline in plant production, lowered resistance to environmental perturbations, and increased variability in ecosystem processes like plant productivity and water use.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Impact of Biodiversity Loss in Grade 12 Biology.

text:

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Causes of Biodiversity Loss in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Biodiversity Conservation: In Situ

Biodiversity Conservation: In Situ

In situ conservation involves protecting endangered species in their natural habitats by preserving ecosystems, such as through biosphere reserves, national parks, and sanctuaries.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Biodiversity Conservation: In Situ in Grade 12 Biology.

title: NCERT Grade 12 Biology | Biodiversity Conservation: Ex Situ

Ex situ conservation involves protecting endangered species outside their natural habitats, using methods like zoological parks, botanical gardens, and cryopreservation of gametes.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Biodiversity Conservation: Ex Situ in Grade 12 Biology.

Biodiversity hotspots are regions with very high levels of species richness and endemism, which are also regions of accelerated habitat loss, and thus in need of maximum protection.

metadata.subject: Biology

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Double Fertilization in Flowering Plants in Grade 12 Biology.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Human Gametogenesis in Grade 12 Biology.

metadata.subject: Biology
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Fertilization in Humans in Grade 12 Biology.

metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Mendelian Inheritance of Traits in Grade 12 Biology.
